vectors.name: poll_reply_on_change
vectors.description: ArtPoll from Pixelmapper: Flags bit1 (send ArtPollReply on change), no diagnostics, not targeted, EstaMan 0x7FF0, Oem 0x00FF placeholder
vectors.source: Art-Net 4 rev 1.4dp (23/10/2025), ArtPoll packet definition p.18-19
vectors.notes: EstaMan and Oem are big-endian here (Hi byte first) - unlike ArtPollReply.EstaMan which is Lo byte first.
